optimized_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, date_dim.d_date
    FROM customer
    JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
) AS store_hits
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, date_dim.d_date
    FROM customer
    JOIN catalog_sales ON catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
) AS catalog_hits
    ON store_hits.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM catalog_hits.c_last_name
   AND store_hits.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM catalog_hits.c_first_name
   AND store_hits.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM catalog_hits.d_date
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, date_dim.d_date
    FROM customer
    JOIN web_sales ON web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
) AS web_hits
    ON store_hits.c_last_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM web_hits.c_last_name
   AND store_hits.c_first_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM web_hits.c_first_name
   AND store_hits.d_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM web_hits.d_date
LIMIT 100
